# MenusQR

> MenusQR is a digital QR menu and table-ordering platform for restaurants, cafes, dhabas, bars, hotels, bakeries and food trucks in India. A restaurant prints one QR code per table once; dishes, prices and availability can be changed at any time without reprinting.

## What it does
- Digital menu that opens in the phone browser when a guest scans the table QR. No app download.
- The printed QR code is permanent. Menu edits, price changes and sold-out marks go live instantly.
- Ready-made menu designs (templates), several themed for particular Indian cuisines (Punjabi, South Indian, Mumbai street food, thali, royal/heritage) plus café, bar and international styles, with veg and non-veg marks, portions (half/full), add-ons and dish photos.
- MenusQR is spelled as one word and runs only at menusqr.in. It is not connected to products named MenuQR.
- Premium plan: guests order from the table, orders reach a kitchen screen, and a cashier screen keeps one running bill per table with a thermal-style receipt.
- Each table's QR carries its own hidden table code, so an order always lands on the right table.
- Owner dashboard works on a phone. Support in English and Hindi.

## Plans and prices (INR, per restaurant)
- Basic: ₹559 per month or ₹1,999 per year. Digital menu, QR code, initial menu setup, one included menu edit.
- Intermediate: ₹959 per month or ₹3,199 per year. Everything in Basic plus unlimited menu edits and premium menu designs.
- Premium: ₹1,119 per month or ₹6,799 per year. Everything in Intermediate plus table ordering, kitchen display and cashier billing.
- Current prices and offers: https://menusqr.in/plans
